text:
anya: Heads-up — planning a short compliance drill next Tue 09:30 PST. Goal: validate KMS key rotation + RBAC changes + SBOM attestation + cosign verification in runtime. Need owners and a canary image.
kevin: +1. Which cluster(s)? staging only or do we hit prod readonly? :thinking_face: 
anya: staging first. prod readonly probe via audit-only policy (no writes). ops-oncall will coordinate window.
mike: For RBAC changes, do we want a temporary service account with least privilege for the drill, or simulate a compromised build bot?
leah: temp SA is safer. we can create a SA that has imagePuller + read-only secrets access and then revoke after test. Example patch to bind role: 
```bash
kubectl create serviceaccount drill-sa -n inference-staging
kubectl create rolebinding drill-pull-binding --clusterrole=view --serviceaccount=inference-staging:drill-sa -n inference-staging
```
leah: For cosign/SBOM check workflow: build publishes SBOM + signed digest to artifact registry, runtime fetcher runs `cosign verify` and `sbom verify` before allowing pull. Quick cosign verify snippet: 
```bash
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/cosign-key gcr.io/redwood/staging/canary:sha256-...
```
ops-oncall: I can take the window. I'll schedule a 30m slot, mark as maintenance and set notify oncall rotation. Which CI job will produce the signed SBOM?
anya: build-team will. @mike can you own the publish step + CID in artifact metadata?
mike: I can. I'll also add an ephemeral KMS key version to test rotation effects. Question: do we want to test KMS-enforced access (KMS IAM) or just signature verification with public key fetch?
kevin: Test both. The point of the drill is to ensure a rotated key doesn't break runtime verification and that audit logs are emitted for KMS decrypt/sign operations.
leah: On audit logs — we should verify entries in cloud-logging for: `accesses.googleapis.com` (KMS), `artifactregistry.googleapis.com`, and our runtime service logs (authz decisions). I'll prepare a query.
sec-bot: [auto] Vulnerability scan: baseimage:ubuntu-22.04 — 1 high (glibc) found last scan 3h ago. Recommend patch before canary if it's blocking.
anya: Noted. This drill includes a vuln-triage step — if a blocking CVE exists we'll use a patched canary image. Ops: please hold if image needs rebuild.
ops-oncall: will hold window if rebuild required. Also, add a short rollback plan: if runtime rejects signed images post-rotation, we'll toggle `runtime.image_verification=false` feature-flag and roll back KMS change.
mike: I'll document the rollback steps and add an automated smoke test that exercises `cosign verify`. Smoke test will post status to the incident channel.
kevin: Who's owning post-mortem + audit evidence collection? Need logs, SBOM artifacts, cosign metadata, KMS access logs.
leah: I'll collect SBOM + cosign outputs. @anya can you collect KMS logs and RBAC diffs?
anya: Yep. I'll snapshot IAM policy versions and export KMS audit logs into the investigation bucket.
mike: timeline: prep by Mon EOD, drill Tue 09:30 PST, 30m window, evidence collated by Tue 12:00.
kevin: SGTM. Please add a short checklist in the incident runbook:
- create drill-sa
- push signed canary image + SBOM
- rotate test KMS key version
- run runtime smoke verify
- validate audit logs
- revoke drill SA and KMS key version
leah: I'll add the checklist to the runbook and include the log queries.
anya: Great. If anyone hits blockers please ping #eng-security and page ops-oncall. Thanks all :thumbsup:
